name: DATASONIC
recent: Datasonic 终止了一项价值 RM28.5m 的 PJ 房产交易，原因是消防部门审批条件未满足；随后以 RM15.12m 通过债务结算方式收购两家 AIMAX 子公司。公司于 2026 年 10 月由 NEXG Berhad 更名为 Datasonic Group Berhad，同期执行主席 DATO' Haji Ishak bin Ismail 的关联方在闭市期间多次买卖股份。
notable: 公司终止了一项价值 RM28.5m 的 PJ 房产收购交易，因消防部门审批条件未满足。
公司将以 RM15.12m 收购两家 AIMAX 子公司，作为部分债务结算。
公司于 2026 年 10 月由 NEXG Berhad 更名为 Datasonic Group Berhad。
risks: 执行主席 DATO' Haji Ishak bin Ismail 的关联方在闭市期间多次买卖公司股份，000 股。
公司终止 RM28.5m 房产交易，引发市场对该交易的疑问。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM49.24m，环比下降 52.3%，同比下降 44.3%；净亏损为 RM2.823m，净利率为 -5.7%，较上一季度的 -36.5% 有所收窄，但净利润同比恶化 104.4%。

recent_en: Datasonic terminated a RM28.5m PJ property deal after a Fire Department approval condition was not met, and is acquiring two AIMAX subsidiaries for RM15.12m via a debt settlement. The company changed its name from NEXG Berhad to Datasonic Group Berhad in October 2026, while shares linked to Executive Chairman DATO' Haji Ishak bin Ismail were traded during the closed period.
notable_en: The company terminated a RM28.5m PJ property acquisition as a Fire Department approval condition was unmet.
The company will acquire two AIMAX subsidiaries for RM15.12m as partial debt settlement.
The company changed its name from NEXG Berhad to Datasonic Group Berhad in October 2026.
risks_en: Shares linked to Executive Chairman DATO' Haji Ishak bin Ismail were traded during the closed period, including a disposal of 370,000 shares on 10 Nov.
The termination of the RM28.5m property deal raises questions about the transaction.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM49.24m, down 52.3% QoQ and 44.3% YoY; net loss was RM2.823m with a net margin of -5.7%, improved from -36.5% in the prior quarter but net income deteriorated 104.4% YoY.
